chunks: You did not read any Scripture before this, nor wrote one with your right hand, or else these dissemblers would have found a cause to doubt it.

key_terms.الْمُبْطِلُونَ: the dissemblers or those who deny the truth

ai.seo_question: Why is the Prophet's unlettered nature a proof of the Quran's divine origin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility), suggesting that the Prophet's lack of prior literacy or scribal skill served as a tangible, empirical proof against the polytheists' claims of plagiarism. The phrase 'by his right hand' specifically emphasizes his physical ability to write, ruling out the possibility that he dictated the Quran while someone else transcribed it, thereby securing the text's divine origin from all angles of human doubt.
